UPSSSC Stenographer 09/2023 Documents Upload 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Board (UPSSSC) has released the Skill Test Result for selection to the posts of Stenographer under the Advt No. : 09-Exam/2023. Applications for the UPSSSC Stenographer Recruitment 2023 were accepted from October 17, 2023, to November 06, 2023. The vacancy came in the year 2023 and it took almost two year one month to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. The Skill Test examination was held on 01 September 2026. Candidates who appeared in the written exam can download their UPSSSC Stenographer 09/2023 Skill Test Result 2026 from the direct link provided below.

  • Last Date : 06 November 2023

  • Answer Key : 01 April 2026
  • Result : 22 July 2026
  • Skill Test Exam Date : 01 September 2026
  • Skill Test Admit Card : 25 August 2026
  • Skill Test Result : 27 October 2026
  • Documents Upload : 28 October 2026 to 11 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Dviyang) : Rs. 25/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
